gaps.discriminates: Early-onset sepsis vs. asymptomatic: preterm infants have markedly higher risk independent of symptoms

gaps.info: Pulse oximetry screening results (pre- and post-ductal)
gaps.discriminates: Critical congenital heart disease (e.g., ductal-dependent lesions) vs. asymptomatic: >90% detected by abnormal CCHD screening before symptom onset

gaps.info: Newborn screening results (especially TSH, ammonia, lactate, acylcarnitine profile)
gaps.discriminates: Congenital hypothyroidism or inborn errors of metabolism vs. asymptomatic: these disorders are biochemically detectable at birth but clinically silent initially
